description: Assess the risk of an existing ERC-20 approval on Base BEFORE it can be abused: reads the live allowance an owner has granted a spender, flags UNLIMITED approvals (the allowance-drain vector — a compromised or malicious spender can pull up to the allowance), and reports whether the spender is a contract. Unlimited allowance to an EOA is a classic scam setup. Use before signing an approval, or to audit standing approvals.

owner.description: The wallet that granted the approval

spender.description: The address allowed to spend (router, contract, or EOA)

name: approval_risk
